head.i: Lacedæmon in communionem reipublicæ Achaicæ recepta.

main_text.p: SEd vicit sententia Lycortæ, & Lacedæmon in communionem societatis Achaicæ eft recepta, atque hoc decretum columnæ, quod fieri in iis, quæ firma & immota cenfebantur, folebat, infcriptum: & ex exulum numero illi, qui nunquàm ingrati atque improbi in Achæos animi fignum[illegible, ~3 letters] edidiffent. Mansitque ab eo tempore Lacedæmon confors reipublicæ Achaicæ. His rebus confectis, millus Romam eft ab Achæis Bippus Argivus, à Lacedæmoniis Charon, qui de omnibus senatum facerent certiorem.

Ab exulibus autem Cletis quoque iftuc legatus, qui ipforum caufam contra legatos cæteros tueretur. Qui cum omnes Romæ abundè auditi effent, senatus quidem nihil eorum,[illegible, ~4 letters] quæ à civitate Spartanâ acta erant, reprehendit, aut indignè fe ferre oftendit: exulibus verò promisit, ad Achæos fe fcripturum de illis in patriam restituendis. Idem senatus post aliquot dies Bippo cognoscens, cui id in mandatis etiam erat datum, ut eam rem geftam exponeret, Meslenen quoque priori co[?] & statui ab Achæis esse restituta[?] nec hoc improbavit, legatosque omnes[illegible, ~2 letters]

page.notes: Right margin notes are cut off and overlap the text and each other; only fragments are legible, so they are marked illegible. Doubtful readings: "millus" (probably missus), "Meslenen" (probably Messenen), "co" (probably eo), "restituta", and the catchword "hur", which is partly cut off. The final line is partly obscured by the margin notes.
